events.title: John the Baptist
events.description: John the Baptist appears in the wilderness and preaches a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. He fulfills the words of the prophet Isaiah about a voice crying out in the wilderness. All Judea and everyone in Jerusalem go out to him and are baptized in the Jordan River.

events.title: The Baptism of Jesus
events.description: Jesus comes from Nazareth in Galilee and is baptized by John in the Jordan. As he rises out of the water, he sees the heavens open and the Spirit descend upon him like a dove. A voice from heaven says: "You are my Son, the beloved; with you I am well pleased."

events.title: The Temptation
events.description: The Spirit drives Jesus into the wilderness, where he remains for forty days and is tempted by Satan. He is among the wild animals, and angels serve him. Mark gives the shortest account of the temptation among the Gospels.

events.title: The Calling of the First Disciples
events.description: Jesus walks along the Sea of Galilee and calls fishermen Simon and Andrew to follow him and become fishers of people. Shortly after, he also calls James and John, sons of Zebedee, who immediately leave their father and follow him.

events.title: Healings in Capernaum
events.description: Jesus enters the synagogue in Capernaum and drives out an unclean spirit. He then heals Simon's mother-in-law, who is sick with a fever. In the evening, people bring all the sick and demon-possessed to him, and he heals many.

events.title: The Paralytic Brought to Jesus
events.description: Four men carry a paralyzed man to the house where Jesus is teaching, but cannot get in because of the crowd. They break through the roof and lower the paralytic down. Jesus first forgives his sins, then heals him to show that the Son of Man has authority to forgive sins.

events.title: The Calling of Levi
events.description: Jesus sees Levi, son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax booth and calls him to follow. Levi gets up and follows Jesus. Later, Levi holds a meal where Jesus eats with tax collectors and sinners, which draws criticism from the scribes.

events.title: Sabbath Controversy
events.description: The disciples pick grain on the Sabbath, and the Pharisees accuse them of breaking the Sabbath law. Jesus defends them with the example of David and declares that the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath. In the synagogue he heals a man with a withered hand, and the Pharisees begin to plot against him.

events.title: The Twelve Are Chosen
events.description: Jesus goes up on a mountain and calls those he wants to himself. He chooses twelve who are to be with him and whom he will send out to preach and have authority to drive out evil spirits.

events.title: The Storm Is Calmed
events.description: Jesus and the disciples set out across the Sea of Galilee when a violent storm breaks loose. While Jesus sleeps in the stern, the frightened disciples wake him. He rebukes the wind and the sea and says: 'Quiet! Be still!' The wind dies down completely, and the disciples ask each other who he is.

events.title: Jairus' Daughter and the Woman with Bleeding
events.description: The synagogue leader Jairus asks Jesus to come and heal his dying daughter. On the way, a woman who has been bleeding for twelve years touches Jesus' cloak and is healed. When they arrive, the girl is dead, but Jesus takes her by the hand and raises her to life.

events.title: Feeding of the Five Thousand
events.description: Jesus sees the great crowd and has compassion on them. With only five loaves of bread and two fish he feeds five thousand men. The disciples gather twelve full baskets of leftover bread and fish.

events.title: Peter Confesses Jesus as the Messiah
events.description: At Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asks his disciples who people say he is. Peter answers: 'You are the Messiah.' Jesus forbids them to tell anyone about it and begins for the first time to speak of how the Son of Man must suffer, be rejected, be killed, and rise again after three days.

events.title: The Transfiguration on the Mountain
events.description: Jesus takes Peter, James, and John up a high mountain. There he is transformed before them, and his clothes become dazzling white. Moses and Elijah appear and talk with him. A cloud overshadows them, and a voice from the cloud says: 'This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!'

events.title: The Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem
events.description: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a young donkey while the crowd spreads cloaks and green branches on the road. They shout: "Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" He enters the temple and looks around, but it is already late, so he goes out to Bethany.

events.title: The Cleansing of the Temple
events.description: Jesus enters the temple and drives out those who are buying and selling there. He overturns the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves. He says: "Is it not written: My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations? But you have made it a den of robbers."

events.title: The Olivet Discourse
events.description: On the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, the disciples ask Jesus about the sign that all these things are about to happen. Jesus speaks of persecutions, the great tribulation, and the coming of the Son of Man in the clouds. He urges them to stay awake, for no one knows the day or the hour.

events.title: The Anointing at Bethany
events.description: While Jesus is eating a meal in Bethany in the house of Simon the Leper, a woman comes with an alabaster jar of very expensive pure nard ointment. She breaks the jar and pours the ointment on Jesus' head. Jesus defends her and says that she has already anointed his body beforehand for burial.

events.title: The Last Supper
events.description: Jesus celebrates the Passover meal with the twelve. During the meal, he takes bread, blesses it, and says: "This is my body." He takes the cup and says: "This is my blood, the blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many." He predicts that all the disciples will fall away from him.

events.title: Gethsemane
events.description: Jesus goes to Gethsemane with his disciples and takes Peter, James, and John further inside. He falls to the ground in prayer and prays: "Abba, Father! All things are possible for you. Take this cup from me! Yet not what I will, but what you will." The disciples fall asleep three times while he is praying.

events.title: The Trial and Crucifixion
events.description: Judas betrays Jesus with a kiss, and he is arrested. He is brought before the Council and then before Pilate. Peter denies him three times. Jesus is flogged, mocked, and crucified at Golgotha. At the ninth hour he cries out: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" and gives up his spirit.

events.title: The Empty Tomb
events.description: Early in the morning on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome come to the tomb with fragrant oils. They find the stone rolled away and a young man in white clothing who says: "He has risen, he is not here." They flee from the tomb, seized by fear.
